summary: Serve missions and work collection windows from published lists that background refreshers fold incrementally

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes; the lists live in memory.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Frames keep their shape. A missions or work window's snapshot names the published list's cut and published_at, about a second plus one fold behind at most; before the first publication a window gets a retryable resync. HTTP pages are unchanged. ST3_PUBLISHED_LISTS=off restores folding on read.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption; the first lists fold in short snapshots after start.

recovery.detail: Only volatile in-memory lists change; restart with ST3_PUBLISHED_LISTS=off to fold on read.
